name: Murasaki Isamu
source: The owner of the Akihabara's souvenir shop "Akiba Spot". A charming old man who is however a bit suspicious. Due to his debt, he started selling kurimanjuu (Christmas manjuu) in his shop or otherwise it would've been closed down.
